expected_findings.root_cause: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason to initialize reason, but raw has no underlying response object yet at construction time, so the attribute access dereferences None.
expected_findings.failure_path: Any call that builds a Response, such as every adapter.send or a plain Response(), raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'reason') before the object is populated, so no request can complete.
